plan.notes: Source: https://acu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Information-Technology-BS.pdf (official ACU Online degree plan, 2026-2027 Academic Year, 100% ONLINE, 120 credit hours). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. General concentration modeled (PDF also offers Application Development and Information Assurance concentrations). Caveats: (1) PDF arithmetic is inconsistent: 16 core courses (48 hrs) + 9 hrs concentration + 56 hrs gen-ed + 16 hrs electives = 129, not 120. Modeled with electives = 7 hrs so the plan sums to the official 120-hour total (48+9+56+7=120). (2) ITC 460 prerequisite per PDF: 'must be taken during the last year of the academic program' (placed in Year 4). (3) Semester placement is a recommended sequence; the PDF does not publish a semester-by-semester layout.
